text: CPI just jumped to 4.2% — a 3-year high — while the Fed is stuck holding rates at 3.5–3.75% with no cuts expected through 2027, meaning inflation is running hot with no relief valve, which pressures growth stocks and speculative holdings especially hard.
Rigetti is down 36% and 63% off its high with shrinking revenue, no profits, and negative cash flow — this is a broken thesis and the EXIT signal says get out now to preserve what capital remains.

QBTS is down 20% and nearly 47% off its high with no earnings and negative cash flow — reduce your exposure here because speculative cash-burning stocks face extra headwinds when inflation is elevated and rate cuts are off the table.
NCLP.L is down 18% and 31% off its high with every technical indicator pointing bearish — trim this position to limit further losses since there's no sign yet of a bottom forming.

Adobe is 47% off its high but has rock-solid fundamentals with strong profitability and cash flow — this is a quality business on sale, and adding at these levels gives you a better average cost in a proven money-maker.

ServiceNow is 51% off its high which looks scary, but the underlying business is excellent with strong growth and margins — adding here means buying a best-in-class software company at a meaningful discount.
